profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer @ Nike
profile.summary:
Software developer and consultant with a deep understanding of full-stack AWS technologies using: Docker, React & Redux, Python, Athena SQL & Neptune/Gremlin graph query languages including CI/CD strategies with Terraform and Jenkins. I value client engagement across the entire product lifecycle from concept to production with a heavy emphasis on automated testing so we all sleep well at night. 

* Udacity React Nanodegree (in progress)
* Master of Science, Oriental Medicine, High Honors, National College of Natural Medicine 2010
* Certificate of Advanced Studies in Classical Chinese Medicine, NCNM 2010
* Bachelor of Science, Electrical Engineering and Computer Science, UC Berkeley 2000
* Bachelor of Arts, Cognitive Science, UC Santa Cruz 2000

positions.title: Senior Hardware Design Engineer
positions.description: Design, implementation, testing, and debugging of the Lexica Deep Trace system, a data tracer and engineering tool used by hardware engineers for a leading semi-conductor firm. Travel for on site customer support.

positions.title: Hardware Design Engineer
positions.description:
A key member of a hardware engineering team whose responsibilities include design and support of a new cost-reduced video multiplexer architecture as well as design and implementation of new encoder products. Responsible for design elements including architecture specification writing, schematic capture, part selection and negotiation, FPGA/PLD Verilog coding, placement and layout reviews, as well as lab bring-up, diagnostic testing and debug, organization of QA procedures, FCC, DVT, thermal testing, and release to manufacturing.

Primary engineer responsible for design, implementation, documentiation, and testing of a 12-port switch fabric implemented in an Altera Stratix FPGA with a bandwidth of 1.3 Gbps per link.  This was the backbone of the next-generation encoder product line, responsible for supporting both control and data paths.

Primary engineer for design, implementation, documentation, and testing of a 4 port analog/digital audio compression card supporting MPL2, AC3, and AAC.

Designed and simulated a video filter/re-routing FPGA and backplane management FPGA in a mixed Verilog/AHDL environment.

positions.title: Hardware Design Engineer
positions.description:
Board lead for hardware implementation of a management card for a high-availability dual-redundant chassis based SAN switch.  Responsible for entire design including architecture specification writing, chip selections, thermal simulation, schematic capture, FPGA/PLD Verilog coding, and placement and layout reviews.

The board consisted of a 256 Gbps, 128 port switch network with differential signaling operating at 2.5 GHz with supporting dual-CPUs and a 24 port switched Ethernet management network.  Other design features included extensive DC-DC converters, memory and boot flash expansion, PCMCIA, HDLC, and a Local Bus to PCI converting FPGA.

positions.title: Associate Hardware Design Engineer
positions.description:
Responsible for hardware implementation of board design including specification writing, chip selection, schematic capture, FPGA/CPLD VHDL coding, placement and layout reviews, board bring-up, debugging, and DVT.  

Worked on the following designs for the MAYAN Unifier:
Revised a 28 port DS-1 to VT1.5 SONET mapper board.  
Board lead for a 14 port E1 to VT2 SONET mapper board.  
Lead designer for a Packet Processing FPGA for Frame Relay
